column1: # Pause Anytime's string ids, for translation mods (docs/translating.md). One line per string: the id, a tab, the
# English text (UTF-8). The ids are the same in LE1, LE2 and LE3. A translation mod defines them in its own talk files.
# 74300001 the title of the pause screen and of the banner
# 74300002 Resume, on the pause screen and the banner (without a translation: the game's string 157151)
# 74300003 Photo mode, on the pause screen and the banner (without a translation: the game's own string)
# 74300004 the Space key, on the pause screen
# 74300005 the Esc key, on the banner
# 74300006 the Start button, on the banner
# 74300007 a key and what it does, on the banner: %1 is the key, %2 what it does, each once, with no digit after it
# 74300000 is kept for the mod's name, which nothing shows yet; 74300008 to 74300099 are kept for later words.
# build.sh checks that the lines below match the code (TextRules.hpp) and stops when they differ.
